project.client: Dortech Direct (James, MD) via Andy Claridge, Tremco CPG
project.job: Two-storey garage in Nudura ICF - Option B - Room in the roof
project.model_title: DG-B Two-storey garage in Nudura ICF - Option B - Room in the roof - Quotation Q01

views.title: Raft slab
views.desc: Indicative 200 RC raft with a 600 x 450 thickened edge under the ICF, on DPM and 150 hardcore (engineer to design).

views.title: Nudura ICF walls
views.desc: Nudura 6in Standard on Nudura Bond, 4,858 x 5,061 outside - webs on the grid from both corners, NO stack joints; eaves walls 5 courses to the plate, gables raked to the roof with the gable courses flying out over the corners; garage door, pedestrian door(s), window and the raked feature gable opening with its sill closure. Every form as it would be laid.

views.title: First floor
views.desc: PS9-type 225 metal-web joists @400 spanning front to rear, top-hung on ledgers off the two ICF gables, 22 P5 deck; FFL 2,656, garage ceiling 2,396.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Loose 47 x 147 C24 rafters @400 on a 100 x 320 GL24h glulam ridge bearing in the gables, 55.0 deg, gable ladders (indicative).

views.title: Roof membrane + battens
views.desc: Breathable roofing membrane and 25 x 50 treated battens.

views.title: Tiles, fascia, soffit + rainwater goods
views.desc: Concrete interlocking tiles with dry ridge and verge, PVC-u fascia, soffit and 22 x 225 barge boards, half-round gutters and downpipes.

views.title: Windows + doors
views.desc: Anthracite (RAL 7016) window, composite door(s), the raked aluminium feature screen with its cill, and the sectional garage door (supplier).

views.title: Opening tapes
views.desc: Tremco CPG illbruck ME220 external and ME110 internal window membranes round every opening (garage door excluded).

views.title: Dryvit 500 render
views.desc: Dryvit 500 thin-coat render (Tremco CPG), 7.5 build-up, direct to the Nudura EPS, into the reveals to the frames.

views.title: External steel stair
views.desc: Contemporary galvanised + powder-coated steel stair to the room-in-roof door at FFL: 13 x 200 / 12 x 250, landing 1,300 x 1,100 (indicative - fabricator / engineer).
